facts.text: The Wright Guarantee Tuition Program guarantees the same annual cost of tuition, housing, and dining over a four-year college career for incoming in-state undergraduates.

sources.title: The Wright Guarantee Tuition Program | Enrollment Services | Wright State University
sources.quote: The Wright Guarantee Tuition Program guarantees the same annual cost of tuition, housing, and dining over a four-year college career for new, incoming, in-state, degree-seeking undergraduate students.
